items.title: Unit 8 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
Look! I've got a certificate for good work at school. Well done, Rosy. Go and show your family.

Where's Grandma? Is she in the kitchen? No, she isn't.

Are Dad and Billy in the living room? No, they aren't.

Surprise! Well done, Rosy. Thank you!

And this is the balcony. Look, you can see my favourite tree.
